title: RoboCup@Home skill variant: one priced instance of a skill

id.description: Canonical id. Permanent; never reused. A derived penalty adds -<failure code>.

skill.description: The skill (data/skills.yaml) this variant is an instance of. Many variants share a skill.

variant_number.description: Permanent within its stem. Never reused, never reassigned.

objects.description: Catalog objects, parts or object-set names (vocabulary/) handled by this variant. Supply the object-side difficulty factors.

conditions.description: Situation-side difficulty factors (source: condition in vocabulary/difficulty_factors.yaml) mapped to a level, or to a list of levels when the level is drawn at test time.

failure_mode.description: Penalties only: key of failure_modes in data/skills.yaml, so equal failures can be priced consistently.

points.description: Priced exactly once, here. null only when the rulebook leaves it unpriced or a formula applies.

points_formula.description: Used instead of points when the value derives from the challenge total (e.g. §3.8.3).

at.description: Where the skill happens: places, furniture or furniture groups (vocabulary/furniture.yaml).

failures.description: Failure modes of this variant beyond its skill's (data/skills.yaml failure_modes, scope variant).

penalty_of.description: Derived (dist/ only): the variant this penalty is a share of.

share.description: Derived (dist/ only): the failure mode's share of penalty_of.

used_by.description: Derived by the build (dist/ only); never authored.
